newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Colston released from hospital.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Colston released from hospital.

text.p: Key Australian independent Senator Mal Colston, under police investigation for alleged abuse of travel expenses, has been released from a Brisbane hospital where he has been recovering from an undisclosed illness.
A hospital official said in a statement that Colston was currently convalescing at an undisclosed location.
The hospital earlier said it would release a major announcement from Colston who has been under pressure to resign from his role as deputy president of the Senate and from the Senate itself.
A statement released by The Wesley Uniting Church Private Hospital and signed by Colston thanked the staff of hospital for looking after him but made no comment on his political future.

The government has called for his resignation as deputy president of the Senate while the Labor Opposition, from which Colston defected to become an independent in August last year, has called for Colston's resignation from the Senate.

Prime Minister John Howard's year-old conservative government does not have a Senate majority and has relied on support from Colston and another independent to pass key reforms, including budget cuts, through the Senate.

Howard, who has seen his public support slip over his handling of the scandal, said on Wednesday he still considered Colston innocent pending the outcome of police investigations, but he said the government would no longer accept his support.
